content.text: he believed in the Lord, Gen. 15:6. Moses answered … they will not believe me, nor hearken, Ex. 4:1. people believed … and worshipped, Ex. 4:31. people … believed the Lord, and his servant Moses, Ex. 14:31. how long will it be ere they believe me, Num. 14:11. ye believed me not, to sanctify me, Num. 20:12. Yet in this thing ye did not believe the Lord, Deut. 1:32. their fathers, that did not believe in the Lord, 2 Kgs. 17:14. Believe in the Lord your God … believe his prophets, 2 Chr. 20:20. I had fainted, unless I had believed, Ps. 27:13. Because they believed not in God, Ps. 78:22. I believed, therefore have I spoken, Ps. 116:10 (2 Cor. 4:13). The simple believeth every word, Prov. 14:15. he that believeth shall not make haste, Isa. 28:16 (Rom. 9:33; 10:11; 1 Pet. 2:6). ye may know and believe me, Isa. 43:10. Who hath believed our report, Isa. 53:1 (John 12:38; Rom. 10:16; Mosiah 14:1). believe them not, though they speak fair words, Jer. 12:6. no … hurt … because he believed in his God, Dan. 6:23. people of Nineveh believed God, Jonah 3:5. work … which ye will not believe, Hab. 1:5 (Acts 13:41).

as thou hast believed, so be it done, Matt. 8:13. Believe ye that I am able to do this, Matt. 9:28. ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive, Matt. 21:22 (Mark 11:24). Why did ye not then believe him, Matt. 21:25 (Mark 11:31; Luke 20:5). ye believed him not: but the publicans … believed him, Matt. 21:32. here is Christ, or there; believe it not, Matt. 24:23 (Mark 13:21; JS—M 1:21). come down from the cross, and we will believe, Matt. 27:42 (Mark 15:32). repent ye, and believe the gospel, Mark 1:15. Be not afraid, only believe, Mark 5:36. all things are possible to him that believeth, Mark 9:23. Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief, Mark 9:24. when ye pray, believe that ye receive, Mark 11:24. He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved, Mark 16:16. things which are most surely believed among us, Luke 1:1. shalt be dumb … because thou believest not my words, Luke 1:20. lest they should believe and be saved, Luke 8:12. believe only, and she shall be made whole, Luke 8:50. If I tell you, ye will not believe, Luke 22:67. idle tales, and they believed them not, Luke 24:11. O fools, and slow of heart to believe, Luke 24:25. all men through him might believe, John 1:7. even to them that believe on his name, John 1:12. his disciples believed on him, John 2:11. they believed the scripture, and the word, John 2:22. many believed in his name, John 2:23. earthly things … ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things, John 3:12. whosoever believeth in him should not perish, John 3:16. He that believeth on him is not condemned, John 3:18. He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life, John 3:36. Now we believe, not because of thy saying, John 4:42. Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe, John 4:48. himself believed, and his whole house, John 4:53. believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, John 5:24. had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me, John 5:46. This is the work of God, that ye believe on him, John 6:29. there are some of you that believe not, John 6:64. we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, John 6:69. neither did his brethren believe in him, John 7:5. many of the people believed on him, John 7:31. Have any of the rulers or … Pharisees believed on him, John 7:48. if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins, John 8:24. As he spake these words, many believed, John 8:30. because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not, John 8:45. Dost thou believe on the Son of God, John 9:35. I told you, and ye believed not, John 10:25. ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, John 10:26. though ye believe not me, believe the works, John 10:38. glad … I was not there, to the intent ye may believe, John 11:15. he that believeth in me, though he were dead, John 11:25. I believe that thou art the Christ, John 11:27. many of the Jews which came to Mary … believed on him, John 11:45. If we let him thus alone, all men will believe, John 11:48. many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus, John 12:11. While ye have light, believe in the light, John 12:36. had done so many miracles … yet they believed not, John 12:37. among the chief rulers also many believed on him, John 12:42. He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me, John 12:44. if any man … believe not, I judge him not, John 12:47. when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he, John 13:19. ye believe in God, believe also in me, John 14:1. He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do, John 14:12. Of sin, because they believe not on me, John 16:9. have believed that I came out from God, John 16:27. they have believed that thou didst send me, John 17:8. pray … for them also which shall believe on me, John 17:20. that the world may believe that thou hast sent me, John 17:21. he saith true, that ye might believe, John 19:35. that other disciple … saw, and believed, John 20:8. Except I shall see … I will not believe, John 20:25. be not faithless, but believing, John 20:27. because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed, John 20:29. these are written, that ye might believe, John 20:31. many of them which heard the word believed, Acts 4:4. I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son, Acts 8:37. believeth in him shall receive remission of sins, Acts 10:43. by him all that believe are justified, Acts 13:39. as many as were ordained to eternal life believed, Acts 13:48. multitude … of the Jews and … Greeks believed, Acts 14:1. rose up certain … Pharisees which believed, Acts 15:5. certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed, Acts 16:1. Crispus … believed on the Lord with all his house, Acts 18:8. many thousands of Jews there are which believe, Acts 21:20. believing all things which are written in the law, Acts 24:14. King Agrippa, believest thou the prophets, Acts 26:27. I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me, Acts 27:25. unto salvation to every one that believeth, Rom. 1:16. justifier of him which believeth in Jesus, Rom. 3:26. Abraham believed God, Rom. 4:3 (Gen. 15:6; Gal. 3:6; James 2:23). Who against hope believed in hope, Rom. 4:18. believeth on him shall not be ashamed, Rom. 9:33 (10:11). believe in thine heart that God … raised him, Rom. 10:9. call on him in whom they have not believed, Rom. 10:14. Lord, who hath believed our report, Rom. 10:16. ye in times past have not believed God, Rom. 11:30. believeth all things, hopeth all things, 1 Cor. 13:7. if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, 1 Cor. 14:24. god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, 2 Cor. 4:4. what part hath he that believeth with an infidel, 2 Cor. 6:15. promise … might be given to them that believe, Gal. 3:22. after that ye believed, ye were sealed, Eph. 1:13. greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, Eph. 1:19. not only to believe on him, but also to suffer, Philip. 1:29. all might be damned who believed not the truth, 2 Thes. 2:12. God was manifest in the flesh … believed on in the world, 1 Tim. 3:16. Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe, 1 Tim. 4:10. I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded, 2 Tim. 1:12. we which have believed do enter into rest, Heb. 4:3. he that cometh to God must believe, Heb. 11:6. believest that there is one God … devils also believe, James 2:19. ye see him not, yet believing, 1 Pet. 1:8. Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up, 1 Pet. 1:21. we should believe on the name of his Son, 1 Jn. 3:23. believe not every spirit, but try the spirits, 1 Jn. 4:1. we have known and believed the love that God hath, 1 Jn. 4:16. that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness, 1 Jn. 5:10. unto you that believe on the name of the Son, 1 Jn. 5:13. Lord … afterward destroyed them that believed not, Jude 1:5.

Neither did they believe that Jerusalem … could be destroyed, 1 Ne. 2:13. if ye shall believe in Christ ye will believe in these words, 2 Ne. 33:10. if you believe all these things see that ye do them, Mosiah 4:10. whosoever is baptized … shall believe in my name, Mosiah 26:22. began to persecute those that did not believe, Alma 4:8. transgressions of those who believe on his name, Alma 11:40. lead them to believe in my words, Alma 17:29. as many as did believe were baptized, Alma 19:35. Lamanites were brought to believe … were firm, Alma 24:19. there was no law against a man’s belief, Alma 30:7. thou believest, but thou art possessed, Alma 30:42. if a man knoweth a thing he hath no cause to believe, Alma 32:18. if ye believe on his name ye will repent, Hel. 14:13. whoso believeth in me believeth in the Father, 3 Ne. 11:35. more blessed are they who shall believe in your words, 3 Ne. 12:2. they shall believe in me, that I am Jesus Christ, 3 Ne. 20:31. that ye may believe the gospel of Jesus Christ, Morm. 3:21. believe in Jesus Christ, Morm. 7:5. never has man believed in me as thou hast, Ether 3:15.

that they may believe the gospel, D&C 3:20. if they will not believe my words, they would not believe you, D&C 5:7. whosoever believeth on my words, them will I visit, D&C 5:16. even to them that believe on my name, D&C 11:30 (45:5; 49:12). in faith believing, you shall receive the Holy Ghost, D&C 14:8. all men must repent and believe on the name of Jesus Christ, D&C 20:29. show … wonders, unto all those who believe, D&C 35:8. unto them that believed … gave I power, D&C 45:8. To others it is given to believe on their words, D&C 46:14. Ye endeavored to believe that ye should receive, D&C 67:3. ye believed not my servants, D&C 133:71. in the free exercise of their religious belief, D&C 134:7.

Satan … commanded … Believe it not; and they believed it not, Moses 5:13. believed … should be saved; … believed not … damned, Moses 5:15. they would not hearken … nor believe, Moses 5:57. Believe and repent … and be baptized, Moses 8:24.
